events.content:
Migration complete. The build succeeded with both routes (`/` and `/about`) detected by the App Router.

**Changes made:**
- `app/layout.tsx` — root layout with `<html>`/`<body>`, shared `metadata` (title template, description, favicon) and `viewport` exports
- `app/page.tsx` — home page with per-page `metadata` export; `next/head` removed, `<a>` replaced with `next/link` `Link` for client-side navigation
- `app/about/page.tsx` — same migration pattern as home
- `pages/` directory removed (including `_app.tsx` and `_document.tsx`, which are no longer needed in the App Router)

**Key App Router conventions applied:**
- `next/head` → `metadata` export
- `<a href="/about">` → `<Link href="/about">` from `next/link`
- `viewport` meta → separate `viewport` export (Next.js 14+ requirement)
- HTML shell moved to `app/layout.tsx`
